acceptanceCriteria: script/check-line-citations.sh scans docs/AUTOMATION.md, or the doc records why it is exempt.
Every path:line citation in docs/AUTOMATION.md carries a verified @hex anchor and line-citations-check passes.
body: Follow-up from V1-0992 (branch claude/v1-0992-automation-citations, head d2108169, 2026-10-07): the lane repinned 10 help.go citations in docs/AUTOMATION.md, but script/check-line-citations.sh's scanned_doc regex omits that file, so the anchors are never verified and the citations can drift again unnoticed. Adding it requires anchoring every other citation in the page. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.
title: line-citations-check: scan docs/AUTOMATION.md so its help.go anchors cannot drift (V1-0992 follow-up)
